method: Paired nonparametric stay-cluster bootstrap; NumPy PCG64, 2000 resamples, common stay sample across arms and all ten seeds, float64 summation, linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
estimand: Mean over ten seeds of the admissible-minus-none pooled RMSE difference; take each root before averaging seeds.
limitations: Conditional on fitted checkpoints and selected caps; no fitting or seed resampling. Stays are clusters, not identified persons. Repeated admissions and hospital sampling are outside this interval.
